author: TotallyBeast
body: Me and my friend _HyperShock_, were playing Nebula. _Nathy then kicked me for "team greifing." I went back on and started building and then she tempbanned me for a day. My friend _HyperShock_, in defence of me, says that I didn't do anything wrong. He then gets banned by _Nathy! This is outrageous! He was only in my defense, as a friend. We were just trying to play together and then chaos happened. This was a <u>simple mistake</u>. Please unban _HyperShock_ and untempban me. I really love this server and I have played this server for years. I donated 50$ to get diamond class and you can look what _HyperShock_ stated to _Nathy. He was very polite and trying to help me so we can play together. Thank You- legolasgollum

replies.author: TotallyBeast
replies.body:
We are taking further privacy precautions as a family, because of how this was presented and the means to how you think it should be resolved.

As a parent, I don't feel this was handled appropriately nor do I agree with your biased control of banning my son and his friend from a server. You think you're seeing things clearly from one side of the screen, but you have no idea what you're talking about. You were completely out of line on multiple fronts, in my opinion and you offer zero empathy nor an apology for your inappropriate methodology of resolution. 

Clearly, you guys have all the control of whether to ban someone or not and how you think they should be "unbanned".  What good is the appeal process if we don't have a voice in the matter nor has the process ever been explained. 

If you want this to be over, then take reasonable action and unban legolasgollum and _HyperShock_ immediately. Also, do not ever suggest to anyone to go onto one of your private accounts and send them a picture. That's what upsets us the most. As moderators and a support team, you should have clear protocols as well as check and balances of how to handle situations like this.

We've been more than patient with this to get resolved and yet nothing is happening. All we get is sorry for the inconvenience or a different email to utilize. Please tell us the process and we'll do what's necessary.

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hello there,

Nathy is currently unavailable but I will notify him of this ongoing appeal and try to get it seen to as soon as possible.

I would also like to respond to some of the points you have brought up; we, as a moderating team, try to be as professional as we can, as well as not being bias towards certain individuals. In cases like these, unless you can prove the two different accounts belong to two different people then we will presume you broke the rules and will therefore recieve the appropriate punishment for it.

"As a parent, I don't feel this was handled appropriately nor do I agree with your biased control of banning my son and his friend from a server." Firstly, I find this statement completely and utterly unreasonable. The moderator who banned your son and his friend has not been bias in anyway whatsoever. He was following the guidelines and gave out the correct punishment. Your son was breaking a rule and the moderator who banned him did nothing wrong.

"Clearly you guys have all the control of whether to ban someone or not..." Yes we do, it's our own opinions together with the guidelines written and given out by the senior staff team. If someone believes their punishment is unjust, they can appeal it on the forums just as you have done and we will review it, just as we have done.

It looks as if you have grown rather impatient, but we do require some sort of evidence to confirm that these two accounts are not owned by the same person. What Nath proposed was a mere suggestion, we could also organise for both of those accounts to log on to a server and type messages/play some sort of mini game to prove there are two separate people behind the controls. 

Just because you might be upset at these punishments does not mean we can unban both the accounts right now. As far as we are concerned these accounts are linked and one has been used to evade a ban on the other. Until we can organise a way to prove both accounts are not owned by the same person we will get nowhere, unless we decide to give you the benefit of the doubt.

Thank you for your time,

Spoookeh, Avicus Network Moderator

replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
As you've stated above, I only see from one side of the screen. That's completely true and as a result I am almost completely ignorant of the other side of the screen.

As a result of this ignorance, a moderator must turn to using their own judgement. From my side of the screen, all I saw is that I tempbanned someone and then a minute or so later another account comes on and starts asking for the ban to be lifted. To me the time between me tempbanning legolasgollum and hypershock first messaging me over that tempban seemed very similar to the time taken to change minecraft accounts and log back on and this lead to me making the ban evading punishments. About it 9 times out of 10 when this happens they are the same person wanting their other account unbanned. That's my side of the screen. Hopefully you are the 1/10 times, but how can we be sure?

However you've stated that hypershock is legolasgollum's friend in real life, playing at his house and therefore the ip logs show them using the same internet. That in itself is perfectly fine. However what if everyone who ban evaded said it was their friend over at their house? How do the staff tell the difference between players who were playing at a friend's house and those who are only saying that to get out of a permanent ban?

That is why we need some form of evidence to be provided to contradict our own evidence of ban evading. As mentioned earlier, I only get to see one side of the screen. I don't know if I am dealing with 2 players who don't deserve to be banned, or one player with 2 accounts who deserves to be banned but is saying the other account belongs to his friend.

I'm sorry that this appeal has taken so long as it has been hard to receive evidence proving 2 different players, I hope we can work together to sort this out ASAP.

If hypershock and legolasgollum could possibly fight each other on a different server with me spectating, I would consider that adequate proof that there are 2 different people behind 2 different screens. If its at all possible, could we figure out a time where this could take place? I live in Australia, so timezones could make this a bit tricky, but name some times and dates and I'll see what I can do.


Regards,

Nathy
